whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.subtitle: Connect the local development WhatsApp number.
whatsapp.instructions: Generate a QR code, then scan it in WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices.
whatsapp.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Send a message to the paired number to test the bot.
whatsapp.retryHistoryConfirm: This will briefly disconnect WhatsApp and reconnect the saved session to retry history sync. New bot replies may pause briefly. It may fetch another batch, but a complete sync is not guaranteed. Continue?
whatsapp.retryHistoryStarted: Reconnect started. WhatsApp may be briefly unavailable; history sync may continue in the background.
whatsapp.retryHistoryError: Could not restart the WhatsApp connection. Check that Evolution API is available, then try again.
whatsapp.error: Could not reach the local WhatsApp service.
whatsapp.alreadyConnected: WhatsApp is already connected; no new QR code is needed.
whatsapp.qrWaiting: Waiting for Evolution API to provide a QR code…

prompt.title: System prompt

faq.title: FAQ knowledge base
faq.subtitle: Q&A pairs the agent answers from, grounded — no hallucinations.
faq.question: Question
faq.deleteConfirm: "{{question}}" will be removed from the knowledge base. The agent will no longer answer from it.
faq.reembedError: The embeddings provider failed — try again
faq.embeddingModeOn: Best for more than 50 FAQs; retrieves the closest matching entries.
faq.embeddingModeOff: Fast mode for a small FAQ base; gives the agent up to 50 FAQs to handle nuanced questions.
faq.modeSaveError: Could not save FAQ search mode
faq.empty: No entries yet. Create the first one so the agent has something to answer from.

preview.title: Retrieval preview

preview.noResults: No matches — the agent would answer honestly that it doesn't know.
